name: Beam Launcher Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished gloves, ranged weapon or arcanatech arm with a slot which can store a catalyst. As an action, the wearer can make a projectile attack using the engineering skill modifier at the time of crafting as the attack check to fire a ray of energy that deals damage of the catalyst's type to a target within 4 units + the engineering skill modifier at the time of crafting. The damage is based on the quality of the catalyst, with beginner dealing 1d6, novice 1d10, journeyman 2d6, expert 3d8 and master 4d10. The catalyst is destroyed if the user rolls a 1 on an attack check with the launcher.
ingredients: 4 Mechanical Parts, Steel Ingot, Pinch of Powdered Platinum

name: Burst Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished gloves, boots, arcanatech arm or arcanatech leg with a slot which can store a catalyst. As a free action, the wearer can enhance their next unarmed attack on their turn by activating the catalyst, dealing bonus damage of the catalyst's type. The damage is based on the quality of the catalyst, with beginner dealing 1d6, novice 1d10, journeyman 2d6, expert 3d8 and master 4d10. The catalyst is destroyed if the user rolls a 1 on the unarmed attack.
ingredients: 4 Mechanical Parts, Steel Ingot, Pinch of Powdered Platinum

name: Arcanatech Oculus
description: Creates an eye that can be used to replace a biological one to allow the user to gain Standard Vision up to 10 Units by combining either Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots, mechanical parts, powdered platinum, and a journeyman catalyst. Attaching an Arcanatech Oculus reduces the users max health and lightning mitigation by 1. If the user takes more than 15 lightning damage after applying migations, the eye is disabled for 1 minute. Additionally, the enhancement can support a number of infusions based on the quality of the material used with steel allowing 1, aetherium 2 and starsteel 3.

name: Arcanatech Cochlear Device
description: Creates an cochlear device that can be be placed inside or on top of an ear to allow hearing by combining either, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots, mechanical parts, powdered platinum, and a Journeyman Catalyst. Attaching an Arcanatech Cochlear Device reduces the users max health and lightning mitigation by 1. If the user takes more than 15 lightning damage after applying migations, the cochlear device is disabled for 1 minute. Additionally, the enhancement can support a number of infusions based on the quality of the material used with steel allowing 1, aetherium 2 and starsteel 3.

name: Arcanatech Arm
description: Creates an artificial arm that can be used to replace a biological one using either Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots, mechanical parts, and a Novice Catalyst that serves as a power source. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 4. Attaching an Arcanatech arm reduces the users max health and lightning mitigation by 3. If the user takes more than 15 lightning damage after applying migations, the limb is disabled for 1 minute. Additionally, the enhancement can support a number of infusions based on the quality of the material used with steel allowing 1, aetherium 2 and starsteel 3.

name: Arcanatech Leg
description: Creates an artificial leg that can be used to replace a biological one using either Iron, Steel, Aetherium or Starsteel Ingots, mechanical parts, and a Novice Catalyst that serves as a power source. The quality of material allows the crafter to add Infusions with Steel allowing 1 Infusion, Aetherium 2 and Starsteel 4. Attaching an Arcanatech leg reduces the users max health and lightning mitigation by 3. If the user takes more than 15 lightning damage after applying migations, the limb is disabled for 1 minute. Additionally, the enhancement can support a number of infusions based on the quality of the material used with steel allowing 1, aetherium 2 and starsteel 3.

name: Slowfall Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Leg with a Novice Aeromancy Catalyst that reduces the amount of fall damage the user takes by 2 units. An Arcanatech Enhancement cannot have more than one of this Infusion type.

name: Spring Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Leg with an arcane catalyst that increases the Jump distance of the user by 1 Unit. An Arcanatech Enhancement cannot have more than one of this Infusion type.

name: Speed Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Leg with an arcane catalyst that provides the user with bonus Movement Speed based on the quality of the Catalyst with Beginner granting +1 Movement Speed, Journeyman +2 and Master +3. An Arcanatech Enhancement cannot have more than one of this Infusion type.

name: Lifting Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Arm with a Geomancy Catalyst that provides the user with bonus Strength based on the quality of the Catalyst with Beginner granting +1 Strength, Journeyman +2 and Master +3. An Arcanatech Enhancement cannot have more than one of this Infusion type.

name: Reflex Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Arm with a Auguration Catalyst that provides the user with bonus Intiative based on the quality of the Catalyst with Beginner granting +1 Strength, Journeyman +2 and Master +3. An Arcanatech Enhancement cannot have more than one of this Infusion type.

name: Reinforcing Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Leg or Arm Enhancement with a Small Cobalt Ingot and an arcane catalyst that provides bonus Physical Mitigation based on the quality of the Catalyst with Beginner granting +1 Physical Mitigation, Journeyman +2 and Master +3. An Arcanatech Enhancement cannot have more than one of this Infusion type.

name: Antimagic Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Enhancement with a Lead Ingot and a arcane catalyst that provides bonus Arcane Mitigation based on the quality of the Catalyst with Beginner granting +1 Arcane Mitigation, Journeyman +2 and Master +3. Additionally, this infusion causes the limb to become Immutable and immune to magics that would directly disable it.

name: Insulating Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Enhancement with a Coke and Obsidian Dust to reduce the conductivity, removing the Lightning Mitigation penalty and increasing the disable threshold by 15 Lightning Damage.

name: Automated Cooling Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Arm or Leg with a cold catalyst providing bonus Fire Mitigation based on the quality of the Catalyst with Beginner granting +1 Fire Mitigation, Journeyman +2 and Master +3. An Arcanatech Enhancement cannot have more than one of this Infusion type.

name: Backup Power Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Enhancement with a catalyst that provides an additional power source which allows the Enhancement to function in Nullfields or other anti-magic effects for a duration based on the quality of Catalyst used with Beginner being 1 Minute, Novice being 1 Hour and Journeyman being 1 Day. This backup power recharges at the end of a Full Rest.

name: Infravision Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Oculus with a fire catalyst to provide Infravision up to a range based on the quality of the Catalyst used with Novice 2 Units, Journeyman 5 Units and Master 10 Units.

name: Ultravision Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Oculus with an arcane catalyst to provide Ultravision up to a range based on the quality of the Catalyst used with Journeyman 2 Units, Expert 5 Units and Master 10 Units.

name: Magnification Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Oculus with a psychic catalyst to provide a Search bonus based on the quality of the Catalyst used with Journeyman +1 Search, Expert +2 and Master +3. A user of an Arcanatech Enhancement can only benefit from one Magnification Infusion.

name: Amplification Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Cochlear Device with a psychic catalyst to provide a Search bonus based on the quality of the Catalyst used with Journeyman +1 Search, Expert +2 and Master +3. A user of an Arcanatech Enhancement can only benefit from one Amplification Infusion.

name: Detecting Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Cochlear Device with a psychic catalyst to provide Tremorsense up to a range based on the quality of the Catalyst used with Journeyman 2 Units, Expert 5 Units and Master 10 Units.

name: Translation Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Cochlear Device or Oculus with a psychic catalyst to translate either spoken or written languages based on the chosen Enhancement. The languages are determined at the time of crafting and the Arcanatech Enhancement can decipher a number of languages based on the quality of the Catalyst used with Novice allowing 1 Language, Expert 2 and Master 3.

name: Automatic Filtering Infusion
description: Infuse unfinished Arcanatech Cochlear Device or Oculus with a novice psychic catalyst to provide a 1d4 bonus to Vision or Sonic attacks based on the chosen Enhancement.
